guidance: About ₹30 crores have already been deployed and we expect to reach nearly half by the end of this quarter, funded through internal accruals and selective debt.
In the current quarter, we expect to deploy a further ₹17 crores, all of it on solar.
capex: Our ₹100 crore capacity programme is under way.
Our upcoming 9 MW captive solar plant, due for commissioning in the fourth quarter of this year, will meet about 40% of our power needs, and we estimate an annual EBITDA benefit of around ₹8 crores.
risks: They are based on management’s current expectations and are subject to risks and uncertainties, so actual results may differ materially.

On gross profitability, we maintained a healthy gross profit margin of 47.7% in Q2 FY27, broadly stable against 47.6% in Q2 FY26 comparing Year on year, the stability reflects the benefit of product mix and raw-material
focus: This year alone, we showcased new products at Paint India, Plast India and the India Rubber Expo.
Four new products were commercialised in FY26, each solving a specific customer problem, several of them replacing imports.
The total investment is about ₹29 crores and we are targeting commissioning in the fourth quarter of this financial year.
